devdoc.details: The Normal Timelock sources tokens from Risk Fund / Treasury, transfers them to this      contract, sets this contract as pending admin on vTHE, then calls execute() with BNB value.      After execution, admin is handed back to the Normal Timelock.

execute().details: Preconditions:      - All BEP20 tokens have been transferred to this contract by the Timelock      - Native BNB has been sent via msg.value      - Timelock has called vTHE._setPendingAdmin(address(this))

params.token: The token to sweep (address(0) for BNB).

NO_ERROR.details: VToken return value signalling successful execution

TOTAL_THE_SWEEP.details: Maximum total THE to sweep from vTHE across both sweeps.      Capping the sweep preserves internalCash in vTHE so the exchange rate stays > 1.

_approved.details: Tracks whether approval has been set for the current token being processed.      Set on first _repayToken call, reset by _finalizeToken.

devdoc.title: BadDebtHelper

ApproveFailed().notice: Thrown if a contract is unable to approve a transfer

VTokenError(address,uint256).notice: Thrown when a VToken operation returns an error code

execute().notice: Executes the full bad debt repayment flow atomically.

sweep(address,uint256).notice: Allows the Timelock to recover any token or BNB stuck in this contract.

userdoc.notice: Atomically repays bad debt across 19 tokens + native BNB in the BSC Core Pool,         handles THE market recovery (sweep + repay + transfer), and returns remaining assets.
